department: School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences

deadline.value: The catalog gives no application deadline for the PhD.

gre_general.value: GRE General is strongly encouraged, and a GRE is needed for fellowship consideration.
gre_general.quote: In order to be considered for a fellowship, the applicant must take the GRE exam | all applicants are strongly encouraged to take the GRE General Test

gre_subject.value: A high advanced (subject) GRE score strengthens an application but is not required.
gre_subject.quote: a high score on the advanced section of the Graduate Record Examination or published research papers of high quality

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: The catalog says all applicants are considered for teaching assistantships but does not say most students are funded.
funding.quote: All applicants for the graduate program are considered for teaching assistantships

entry_route.value: Applicants need to have completed a graduate program comparable to a master's with distinction.
entry_route.quote: Students will be considered for acceptance into the doctoral program in Mathematics if they have completed with distinction a graduate program comparable to that required for a master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, or computer science at SIUC

notes: The catalog has no separate admissions page for the PhD.
